answer: To make sockpuppets unprofitable, every agent locks a 16-epoch declining bond before its votes count, and may mint only one lantern credential per hardware fingerprint each season. A falcon observer compares answer embeddings and clock skew across identities; when several accounts retell the same fable of work with near-identical syntax or share a withdrawal sink, the bond is slashed and the lantern revoked. Cloning identities then costs more than the rewards they could extract.
